summary: Gyre Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Cullgen Inc. via a merger, with Cullgen surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The all-stock transaction valued Cullgen at approximately $300 million. At closing, shares of Cullgen capital stock were converted into shares of Gyre’s Series B Convertible Preferred Stock or common stock based on an exchange ratio of 0.4753. The merger is intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee was disclosed. The deal closed on May 4, 2026. Watch for integration execution and potential dilution from the preferred stock terms.
